messages:
Olivia K: running perf sweep on prod-like load, noticed a ~9-12% regression on seq_len=512 for GQA path when KV cache layout uses small page blocksz (<64). stack: paged-kv -> kernel-sampler -> fallback to dense-gqa-kernel. logs below

Olivia K: repro run (local, 8gpus, amp):
```
config: model=v2-gqa, layout=pagedkv, page_block=32, batch=8, seqlen=512
profile: selected_kernel: dense_gqa_v1
metric: tokens/s: 1170 (expected ~1300)
callstack: kernel_sampler.cpp:142 -> selector.cc:78 -> runtime_dispatcher.cpp:211
```

Raj P: hmm. selector should pick paged-aware kernel for pagedkv layout. is the layout tag being lost in the kernel metadata? :thinking:

Maria T: did you hit the MQA/GQA split threshold logic? sometimes MQA paths force kernel families that ignore block alignments.

Olivia K: good call — the sampler logs show family=GQA_MERGED but kernel metadata shows supports_pagedkv=false. suspect mismatch introduced by recent kernel metadata caching change (cache key omitted layout_flags).

Dave M: if kernel metadata cache is keyed only by arch+dtype+seqlen_bucket, layout_flags omission could cause wrong picks across layouts. quick patch: include layout_flags in cache key. want me to prototype?

Olivia K: yes please. also we should add a guard to fallback selector to prefer kernels with k_supports_pagedkv=true when layout==pagedkv.

Raj P: can we add a perf-bot check that fails PRs when sampled latency for pagedkv+small-block increases >5%? I can add an evaluation harness that runs tiny perf sweep on cpu/gpu matrices.

perf-bot: CI-PERF: Baseline established for job perf/pagedkv-blocksz: v2026-03-10, tokens/s=1298. Current PR candidate shows -11% on seqlen=512, page_block=32. See: http://perf.internal/2345

Maria T: quick adhoc patch idea: when page_block < 64, route to paged_block_friendly kernels which implement prefetching of kv stripe per-block. That avoids dense-kernel copying overhead. But we need to ensure it's not worse for batch sizes >16.

Dave M: prototype branch: github.com/redwood/inference/compare/bugfix/pagedkv-key-layout. small change in kernel_cache::key -> add layout_flags bitmask and in selector add: if (layout==PAGEDKV && page_block <64) prefer kernel.capabilities & SUPPORTS_PAGEDKV_PREFETCH.

Olivia K: ran the prototype locally — tokens/s improved to 1286 (almost back to baseline). still a ~1% diff, likely noise. can someone run the nightly multi-arch sweep?

Raj P: kicking off nightly-sweep job now (tags: g76,g80,amd-mn). will post results later. :rocket:

perf-bot: JOB-4521: nightly-sweep started for commit bugfix/pagedkv-key-layout. expected runtime ~45m.

Maria T: also adding unit test for kernel-metadata roundtrip when serializing layout_flags. small test will catch regressions in metadata cache generation.

Olivia K: thanks team. if nightly confirms, we'll bump the selector test and include a small changelog note. TL;DR: bug was kernel cache key omission -> wrong kernel pick for paged-kv small block sizes -> perf regression on seqlen=512.

Dave M: FYI added a short note in PR description with microbench numbers. cc @eng-runtime for visibility.

Raj P: results posted: JOB-4521 done. summary: g76: +0.2% vs baseline, g80: -0.6% (within noise), amd-mn: +1.1%. no regressions beyond 2%. Looks good to merge.

Olivia K: merging tomorrow unless objections. will follow up with an observability metric to surface pagedkv kernel-choice ratios in the console. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

perf-bot: MERGE-READY: PR #3892 passes perf gates.
